spots.name: Santa Rosa Island / Wi'ma
spots.tip: eBird birding hotspot with 174 species recorded. Birds are most active in the first two hours after sunrise; recent sightings at ebird.org/hotspot/L109507.

spots.name: Sierra Pablo
spots.tip: A notable summit. Check the road and trail first; first and last light on high ground is the reason to go, and it's often the subject from below. Summit 341 m (1,119 ft).

spots.name: Vail Peak
spots.tip: A notable summit. Check the road and trail first; first and last light on high ground is the reason to go, and it's often the subject from below. Summit 484 m (1,588 ft).
